security.summary: Several unescaped HTML output points ({!! !!}) exist in Blade templates, including one that renders raw database content ($material->content) with no sanitization. The button component constructs HTML tag attributes via string concatenation and emits them unescaped, creating a potential injection surface. The EnumSelect component supports an `allowHtml` mode that bypasses Blade's auto-escaping. SetLocale middleware correctly validates the locale, but the LanguageController relies on `redirect()->back()` which can be manipulated via the Referer header.

findings.title: Raw model content rendered without sanitization in Blade template
findings.description: resources/views/components/blocks/educational_material_detail.blade.php line 53 outputs `$material->content` via `{!! !!}`, bypassing Blade's auto-escaping entirely. If `content` contains user-supplied data or CMS-entered HTML, this is a stored XSS vector.
findings.fix: Pass content through a sanitization library (e.g. HTMLPurifier or `strip_tags` with an allowlist) before rendering, or use `{{ $material->content }}` if rich HTML is not needed. Example: `{!! purify($material->content) !!}`

findings.title: Button component injects user-controlled HTML tag attributes unescaped
findings.description: resources/views/components/ui/button.blade.php line 54 emits `{!! $tagAttr !!}` and `{!! $attributes->except(['class']) !!}`. The `$tagAttr` string is constructed from the `$tag` and `$href` props which can originate from caller-controlled data. A javascript: href or an injected attribute string could execute arbitrary JS.
findings.fix: Whitelist the tag (button/a only), validate `$href` against safe protocols (https/http), and use `{{ }}` or `e()` for all attribute values. Avoid dynamic tag name injection entirely by using an `@if` directive.

findings.title: EnumSelect allowHtml mode emits unsanitized icon SVG/class strings into HTML
findings.description: app/Filament/Forms/Components/EnumSelect.php:193-196 renders icon values (SVG content or CSS class strings sourced from enum cases) directly into HTML using string concatenation when `allowHtml=true`. A compromised or malformed enum case icon value could inject HTML/JS.
findings.fix: Sanitize $icon with an SVG-safe HTML purifier and escape $label with `e($label)` before concatenation. Consider disabling the allowHtml mode by default and documenting the trust requirement.

findings.title: LanguageController uses redirect()->back() vulnerable to open redirect via Referer
findings.description: app/Http/Controllers/LanguageController.php:28 calls `redirect()->back()` after a locale switch. Laravel's `back()` helper uses the Referer header, which can be forged to redirect users to an external malicious URL if not already protected by same-origin middleware.
findings.fix: Use `redirect()->to(url()->previous('/'))`  or validate the Referer header against the application's own domain before redirecting: `return redirect(Str::startsWith($prev = url()->previous(), config('app.url')) ? $prev : '/');`

quality.summary: The module has consistent use of `declare(strict_types=1)` and PHPDoc annotations, but suffers from duplicate class/file pairs (e.g. `app/Data/UserData.php` vs `app/Datas/UserData.php`, `app/Http/Kernel.php` vs `app/Http/Kernel.php.no`), commented-out dead code blocks, and duplicated PHPDoc `@param` tags across many methods. The `audit-coverage/tests/` directory contains 110 stub test files that do nothing but `assertTrue(true)`, inflating perceived test count.

findings.title: Duplicate UserData class in two separate namespaces
findings.description: `app/Data/UserData.php` (namespace `Modules\UI\Data`) and `app/Datas/UserData.php` (namespace `Modules\UI\Datas`) define near-identical DTOs for the same concept. `GetUserDataAction` imports from `Datas` while other code may use `Data`. This creates ambiguity and maintenance risk.
findings.fix: Consolidate to a single canonical `app/Datas/UserData.php` (or `app/Data/`), remove the duplicate, and update all imports. Add a PHPStan/Psalm rule to prevent future duplicates.

findings.title: Dead file app/Http/Kernel.php.no left in source tree
findings.description: `app/Http/Kernel.php.no` is an abandoned backup of the HTTP Kernel with now-removed middleware (TrustProxies). It is not autoloaded but pollutes the repository, creates confusion during reviews, and may be accidentally restored.
findings.snippet: class Kernel extends HttpKernel { // TrustProxies::class still referenced
findings.fix: Delete `app/Http/Kernel.php.no` and any other `.php.no`, `.php.disabled`, `.php.disabled2`, `.php.fila3`, `.php.to_geo` files that are leftover disabled variants.

findings.title: 110 audit-coverage stub tests that only assert `assertTrue(true)`
findings.description: `audit-coverage/tests/01-AuditBridgeTest01.php` through `110-AuditBridgeTest110.php` each contain a single method that trivially passes. These files are machine-generated scaffolding masquerading as test coverage and pollute CI output with meaningless assertions.
findings.fix: Remove the entire `audit-coverage/` directory from the repository. Real coverage should be measured by actual Pest tests under `tests/`.

findings.title: Commented-out validation logic in OpeningHoursRule
findings.description: `app/Rules/OpeningHoursRule.php` contains two large commented-out code blocks (the time-format validator `isValidTimeFormat` and the original foreach loop). Commented-out code creates confusion about intended behavior and is a maintenance smell.
findings.fix: Either re-enable time-format validation (the `isValidTimeFormat` regex is correct) or delete the commented blocks. Track the intent in a GitHub issue rather than in-code comments.

findings.title: Duplicated @param PHPDoc tags on multiple methods
findings.description: Several methods throughout the codebase (e.g. `LocationSelector::getProvinceOptions`, `LocationSelector::labels`, `InlineDatePicker::enabledDates`) have the same `@param` tag repeated twice in the docblock, indicating copy-paste errors.
findings.snippet:
* @param string $region Codice regione
 * @param string $region Codice regione
findings.fix: Remove duplicate `@param` lines and enable a PHPStan/psalm rule (e.g. `phpstan/phpstan-strict-rules`) that flags duplicate docblock tags.

performance.summary: The LocationSelector component performs up to three separate unbounded database queries on every Livewire re-render (region, province, CAP options), with no caching. The InlineDatePicker calls `getEnabledDates()` twice per day cell check, meaning the closure is evaluated repeatedly per render. The GetAllIconsAction uses Reflection to walk every registered SVG file on disk, which is uncached and expensive if called during a request.

findings.title: LocationSelector fires 3 uncached DB queries per Livewire render cycle
findings.description: `getRegionOptions()`, `getProvinceOptions()`, and `getCapOptions()` each issue a raw `Comune::query()` every time the Filament form re-renders (e.g. on every Livewire update). With no query result caching these can hammer the database on busy forms, especially since region options never change.
findings.fix: Wrap each options method with Laravel's `Cache::remember()`: `return Cache::remember('ui.regions', 3600, fn() => self::normalizeStringOptions(...));`. Province/CAP caches should be keyed on the parent selection value.

findings.title: isDateEnabled() calls getEnabledDates() on every calendar day cell
findings.description: `InlineDatePicker::isDateEnabled()` calls `$this->getEnabledDates()` which re-evaluates the closure and re-builds the Collection on every call. In `generateCalendarData()` this is called once per day cell (up to 42 times per render).
findings.fix: Compute enabled dates once and store in a property: `$this->resolvedEnabledDates ??= $this->getEnabledDates();` — or memoize inside `getEnabledDates()` using a private nullable property.

findings.title: GetAllIconsAction uses Reflection + full filesystem scan on every invocation
findings.description: `GetAllIconsAction::execute()` uses `ReflectionClass` to access private `$iconSets`, then calls `File::allFiles($path)` on every registered icon path. With large icon sets (FontAwesome, HeroIcons) this can read thousands of files per request with no caching.
findings.fix: Cache the result with a long TTL: `return Cache::rememberForever('ui.all_icons.'.$context, fn() => $this->buildIconList(...));`. Clear the cache on deployment via `php artisan cache:clear`.

architecture.summary: The module has a reasonable separation of concerns with Contracts, Services, Actions, and Filament-specific components. However, several structural issues undermine the design: a non-functional `boot()` method in UIServiceProvider (the docblock for `boot` is immediately followed by `getComponentViewPath` with no actual `boot` body), scattered disabled/legacy files throughout app/, a direct hard-coded dependency on `Modules\Geo\Models\Comune` inside a UI module component (breaking module isolation), and Reflection used to access a private property of a third-party class.

findings.title: UI module directly depends on Modules\Geo\Models\Comune, breaking module isolation
findings.description: `app/Filament/Forms/Components/LocationSelector.php` directly imports and queries `Modules\Geo\Models\Comune`. A UI module should not hard-depend on a domain-specific Geo module; this creates a tight coupling that prevents using LocationSelector without Geo and breaks the modular architecture.
findings.fix: Introduce a `GeoRepositoryContract` (similar to the existing `MapServiceContract`/`GeocodingServiceContract` pattern) and bind it in `UIServiceProvider` with a Null implementation. LocationSelector should depend only on the contract, with the real Comune implementation injected by the Geo module.

findings.title: UIServiceProvider boot() method is missing — only a docblock placeholder exists
findings.description: `app/Providers/UIServiceProvider.php` has a docblock for `boot()` but no actual method body — the docblock is immediately followed by `getComponentViewPath()`. This means any boot-time setup (view composers, blade component registration) is silently skipped.
findings.snippet:
/**
 * Boot del service provider.
 * ...
 */

/**
 * Restituisce il percorso...
 */
public function getComponentViewPath(): string
findings.fix: Add an explicit `public function boot(): void { parent::boot(); /* explicit registrations */ }` method or remove the misleading docblock if the parent's boot() is sufficient.

findings.title: Reflection used to access private third-party property in GetAllIconsAction
findings.description: `GetAllIconsAction` uses `ReflectionClass` to access the private `$iconSets` property of `BladeUI\Icons\Factory`. This is a fragile coupling to a library internal that could break on any upstream version bump without compile-time warning.
findings.fix: Check if `BladeUI\Icons\Factory` exposes a public API (e.g. `getSets()` or similar). If not, open a PR upstream or cache the icon manifest at asset-build time and load from the cached file instead.

findings.title: Multiple disabled/legacy variant files committed to source tree
findings.description: Files like `UserCalendarWidget.php.disabled`, `UserCalendarWidget.php.disabled2`, `UserCalendarWidget.php.fila3`, `ApplyCalendarToPanelAction.php.disabled`, `LocationSelector.php.to_geo` are committed to the repository. They are not autoloaded but create confusion and risk accidental restoration.
findings.fix: Delete all `.disabled`, `.disabled2`, `.fila3`, `.no`, `.to_geo` files. Use git history for recovery if needed. Establish a convention (e.g. a `_archive/` branch) for long-lived parking of code.

testing.summary: The module declares test infrastructure (Pest, TestCase, factories) but has zero actual test assertions. The 110 files in `audit-coverage/tests/` each contain only `assertTrue(true)` and provide no real coverage. The static analyzer already flagged 'No Tests Found'. Critical components like LocationSelector, InlineDatePicker, OpeningHoursRule, and IconStateColumn have no corresponding tests.

findings.title: Zero real tests despite complete test infrastructure
findings.description: The module has a fully configured Pest environment (testbench.yaml, phpunit.xml.dist, tests/TestCase.php, tests/Pest.php, factories for Category/Collection/FieldOption) but contains no actual test cases. All 110 audit-coverage bridge tests are trivial stubs. Business-critical components (OpeningHoursRule validation, LocationSelector, EnumSelect, IconStateColumn state transitions) are completely uncovered.
findings.snippet:
// helpers defined: createCategory, makeCategory, createCollection, makeCollection
// but no it('...') / test('...') test functions anywhere
findings.fix: Add Pest feature tests for at minimum: (1) `OpeningHoursRule` — assert valid/invalid time ranges; (2) `LocationSelector::validate()` — assert region-required-for-province error; (3) `EnumSelect` — assert options generated from a backed enum; (4) `LanguageController::switch()` — assert unsupported locale falls back to default.

findings.title: Test database hardcoded to fixcity_data.sqlite path
findings.description: `tests/TestCase.php:45` hardcodes `database_path('fixcity_data.sqlite')`. This path is project-specific and will not exist in a fresh checkout or CI environment, making tests impossible to run out of the box.
findings.fix: Use SQLite in-memory (`:memory:`) for unit/feature tests, or provide a seeded fixture via a git-tracked migration. Replace the hardcoded path with an environment variable: `env('TEST_DB_PATH', ':memory:')`.

findings.title: audit-coverage stub files should be removed
findings.description: 110 files in `audit-coverage/tests/` assert only `assertTrue(true)`. They exist solely to inflate file counts and have no diagnostic value. They will also appear in coverage reports, falsely boosting line-coverage metrics.
findings.fix: Delete the entire `audit-coverage/` directory. Invest the effort in real tests under `tests/` that exercise actual module behaviour.

documentation.summary: The module has extensive documentation (30+ markdown files in docs/), a README, and inline PHPDoc throughout. However, the documentation quality is undermined by massive duplication — many docs appear to be AI-generated variations of the same content (architecture.md, architecture-archive-1.md, architecture-archive-2.md, architecture-.md are all near-identical). Public API methods frequently have duplicate @param tags, and the CHANGELOG contains only 4 lines with no version history.

findings.title: Massive documentation duplication across dozens of near-identical markdown files
findings.description: The `docs/` directory contains files such as `architecture.md`, `architecture-.md`, `architecture-archive-1.md`, `architecture-archive-2.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, each 15KB+ and essentially identical. Similarly `best-practices.md`, `best-practices-1.md`, `best-practices_1.md` etc. This makes it impossible to know which document is authoritative.
findings.fix: Establish a single canonical doc per topic and delete duplicates. Use a `docs/archive/` subdirectory for deprecated versions. Add a `docs/00-INDEX.md` as the single entry point and enforce it via a CI lint check.

findings.title: CHANGELOG.md contains only 4 lines — no version history
findings.description: Both `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/CHANGELOG.md` are effectively empty (104 bytes), providing no version history for consumers of this module as a Composer package.
findings.fix: Adopt Keep a Changelog format (https://keepachangelog.com). Document at minimum the current version's additions, changes, and breaking changes. Automate with a tool like `conventional-changelog` or `git-cliff`.

findings.title: README.md lacks installation, configuration, and usage examples
findings.description: The README (57 lines, 1992 bytes) does not cover: required environment variables, how to configure supported_locales, how to register map/geocoding service overrides, or how to use key components like LocationSelector or InlineDatePicker.
findings.snippet: // 57 lines — missing: installation steps, env vars, component usage examples
findings.fix: Add sections: Installation, Configuration (config/config.php options, supported_locales), Key Components (LocationSelector, InlineDatePicker, IconStateColumn usage), Extending (how to swap MapServiceContract binding).

dependencies.summary: PHP dependencies are minimal and intentional, relying heavily on the parent Laraxot platform (Xot, User, Tenant modules via path repositories). The `minimum-stability: dev` setting is a risk as it allows unstable packages into the dependency tree. Both required Composer packages use unconstrained wildcards (`owenvoke/blade-fontawesome: *`) or broad ranges. The npm dependency `axios` is listed as a devDependency despite being a runtime JS dependency, and `dotenv`/`dotenv-expand` are older pinned versions.

findings.title: owenvoke/blade-fontawesome pinned to wildcard * — no version constraint
findings.description: composer.json requires `owenvoke/blade-fontawesome: *` which will accept any version including future major breaking releases. This is dangerous in a package that other modules depend on as it can silently break icon rendering on any composer update.
findings.fix: Pin to a specific major version range: `"owenvoke/blade-fontawesome": "^2.0"`. Run `composer show owenvoke/blade-fontawesome` to identify the current version in use.

findings.title: minimum-stability: dev allows unstable transitive dependencies
findings.description: composer.json sets `minimum-stability: dev` at line 85. While `prefer-stable: true` is set, this still allows unstable (alpha/beta/RC/dev) transitive packages to be resolved, which is inappropriate for a production UI module.
findings.fix: Change to `"minimum-stability": "stable"` unless a specific dependency requires dev stability. If a dev dependency is needed, add a per-package stability flag: `"vendor/package": "dev-main@dev"`.

findings.title: axios listed as devDependency despite being a runtime frontend dependency
findings.description: `package.json` lists `axios: ^1.17.0` under `devDependencies`. Since axios is used in frontend JS code (plugin.js), it should be a production dependency. This means build tools may exclude it from production bundles depending on tree-shaking configuration.
findings.fix: Move `axios` to `dependencies` (not `devDependencies`): `npm install axios --save`. Also verify whether `lodash`, `tippy.js` are used at runtime and should similarly be moved.
